description: Renovate is this repo's sole dependency scanner — the `dependency-management` Freshness renewal mechanism for every pinned dep. Do NOT add .github/dependabot.yml alongside it: both scanners cover the same two managers (github-actions, pip via requirements-dev.txt), so every upstream release arrives as two PRs and each merge publishes a version. That includes the SHA-pinned reusable publish workflow in .github/workflows/publish.yml — Renovate extracts it as a github-tags digest dep and opens `Update jbaruch/coding-policy digest to <sha>` PRs. The Dependency Dashboard renders that pin as a blank row because a digest-only dep carries no currentValue; blank there is not missing coverage.

packageRules.description: The CI python-version pin mirrors the NanoClaw agent container's interpreter (nanoclaw-agent, node:24-slim / Debian bookworm → Python 3.11), not upstream releases. Bump it manually when the container's base image moves. Scoped to the github-actions manager so a future python dep in another manager (Dockerfile, pyproject) still gets update PRs.
